requirements.summary: One deployment serves every brand: Worker API, cron, Workflows class and storefront/admin assets remain together.
D1, R2, hosted Stripe, EmailSender, Access and future vendor boundaries are explicit; no queue or extra custom service is substituted.
Only scaffold/harness is recorded complete; OrderWorkflow.run is empty and the D1 ID is a placeholder. Product tables, checkout, catalog and admin remain future work.
requirements.remainingWork: Implement and verify separately; no source build/scaffold result is promoted to full-product completion.

requirements.summary: CJ/BuckyDrop are planned source adapters; authenticated API and sandbox access are not established by this diagram.
requirements.remainingWork: Verify actual API permissions/contracts and safe recorded fixtures before integration. Assisted vendors remain human-in-the-loop; no bot/scraping/unattended-purchase implementation is supplied.

source.location: §2 Order lifecycle / Seeing what an order does

requirements.summary: Workflows waits/events/timeouts and human resume are durable process semantics, not queue retention or delivery settings.

requirements.summary: Cloudflare Email Sending is behind EmailSender with Resend fallback; selecting a provider does not supply sender setup or templates.
